exercises.instruction: Put the words in the box into the correct column. Some words can go in more than one column.

items: Example: Is your cat old?  No, she's young.
1 Has your sister got long, fair hair?

exercises.instruction: Complete the five sentences describing this man.
Make questions to match the answers on the right, using the words in brackets.
items: Example: (your sister / old / ?) How old is your sister?  She's 14.
4 (your new teacher / look like / ?)  She's tall and slim.
